title: Just perfect!!!
text: Just perfect!!!. This is great! Just what I needed, works exactly as it should. I honestly had never had so much luck finding something like this... these hangers are so hard to find and also so difficult to find good quality ones that actually stay in place and are not a pain in the ass to set up specially when they do stick well. I also was not looking for anything too bulky either and this one fits my shower great, stuck right to the wall, looks good and durable. I really like these, also I got about 4 on the package which is also very nice. Thank you :)

product_metadata.title: SUNDOKI Suction Cup Hooks, Removable Vacuum Holder for Restroom, Bathroom and Kitchen Towel Hanger Storage (4 Pack)
features: 【DAMAGE FREE SUCTION CUP HOOKS】: No Drilling, No Screws, No Holes and No Glue – Perfect for Hanging Your Bags, Clothes, Towels, Kitchen Tools, Bathroom Accessories (4 PACK);
【11 LB WEIGHT CAPACITY】 : Made of high quality ABS material, each suction cup hook can bear strength up to 11 LB and stick sturdy after installation without any concerns;
【REMOVABLE AND REUSABLE】: It allows you to remove and reuse to install suction cup hook to other places again as you want;
【SIMPLE INSTALLATION 】: The package comes with a user manual to tell you how to install it and use tips;

【COMPATIBLE STICKING SURFACES】: Since our suction cup hooks aren’t 3M sticky hooks, our suction cup hooks can’t stick to soiled and painted wall, rug-surface walls and surfaces of wallpaper. They can only work on shiny smooth and flat surfaces, like smooth tiles, glass, metal and so on.
